t: 2032 — First certified ferry hulls service opens: cable drums propulsio
title: 2032 — First certified ferry hulls service opens: cable drums propulsio
definition: 2032 milestone on the Submarine Cable Ferries roadmap.
description:
First certified ferry hulls service opens: cable drums propulsion carrying paying passengers on ferry logistics guideways.

What must be true first: the cable drums results have to replicate outside the lab, ferry logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and route sharing operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed cable drums demonstrations, ferry logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting route sharing uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Estimates Submarine Cable Ferries readiness from component maturity.

Honest scoring is the point: a ferry hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Submarine Cable Ferries Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Submarine Cable Ferries operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Submarine Cable Ferries installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 79407 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where cable drums monitoring, ferry logistics redundancy, or route sharing maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Submarine Cable Ferries Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Submarine Cable Ferries: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Submarine Cable Ferries — ferries doubling as cable layers.

Phase 1 — Prove (cable drums): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (ferry logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (route sharing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (maintenance): ferry hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and islands-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
